<reason>PRO won by holding a limited baseline-not-verdict model: review enforces sources and reports splits while values stay with communities. CON's selection-is-sermon critique was strong but left no test for falsehood beyond the next election, and CON's concession that massacre denial abuses authority plus acceptance of non-electoral checks let PRO argue evidence can overrule the vote and ex ante review protects the child in the room better than ex post repeal.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>Side B's pressure Q1/Q2 on massacre denial and what counts as false forced Side A to define false narrowly as forged brute fact and admit extra-electoral checks, which Side B then used to show framing without fabrication could still sanitize war/empire and that delay is not democratic safeguard.</best_rebuttal>
